attribution: The native bank and selector differ from the equal external recipe bank. Generic choices and resynthesis account for much of the gain; no isolated geometric AGR improvement is claimed.
canonicalization: When the generated AIG payload matched an earlier common input, reuse that input byte-for-byte; both generated and canonical hashes are recorded.
